userPriority: JMdict is especially important; Jitendex and VNDB must also remain qualified.
performanceEvidence: Evaluate complete imports separately on each independent host and order, including all prescribed observations and failures. Preserve paired median, equal-work ratio, faster-pair count, bootstrap interval, absolute milliseconds, and identical-code controls. Never transfer timings between binary identities.
promoteWhen: A replicated practical improvement is distinguishable from identical-code drift, with an understandable mechanism and all correctness, reproducibility, package, and memory checks passing. A small component improvement alone does not establish a worthwhile full-import PR.
inconclusiveWhen: Opposite host directions, intervals spanning material gains and regressions, or control drift comparable to the effect do not justify claiming a full-import gain. Retain results and close the unchanged candidate rather than repeating the cohort until it passes.
resourcePolicy: No threshold, worker-count, batch-size, compression-level, or dictionary-policy tuning. No spending package/storage/memory freely for a minor latency result.
duplicatePolicy: Check current develop, product branches, open PRs, and active full-import cohorts before publication. Keep equivalent ongoing work in one review path.
